about.subtitle: Building intelligent systems at the intersection of AI and software engineering
about.heading: AI Research Meets Real-World Engineering
paragraphs: I'm a graduate Computer Science student at Northeastern University focused on building intelligent systems that combine AI research with real-world software engineering. My work sits at the intersection of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Models, and scalable full-stack development, with a strong interest in creating practical AI products that solve meaningful problems.

I've worked on projects involving anomaly detection, autonomous vehicle systems, multi-agent AI workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI-powered platforms using modern LLM ecosystems. One of my major research-focused projects explores secure Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication for autonomous vehicles using blockchain, AI-driven anomaly detection, and simulation environments like SUMO. I've also built AI applications leveraging IBM Granite models, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows to improve decision-making and automation.

On the software engineering side, I enjoy building end-to-end applications across the MERN stack and modern cloud-native tooling. My experience includes backend architecture, API development, authentication systems, databases, and deploying scalable applications with clean, maintainable code. I'm particularly interested in combining strong engineering principles with AI systems to build products that are both technically robust and impactful.

I enjoy experimenting with emerging AI technologies, exploring how LLMs can enhance developer productivity and user experiences, and continuously learning through research, hackathons, and hands-on projects. My goal is to contribute to the next generation of intelligent software systems that bridge research and production-ready engineering.

projects.subtitle: LLMs, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and Full-Stack Engineering

items.title: Granite Harvest (IBM TechXchange)
items.description: Multi-agent agentic workflow for food redistribution. Designed classification, constraint validation, and intelligent matching across 30+ scenarios in 48hrs. Achieved 85%+ match relevance, 22% accuracy improvement, 94%+ constraint satisfaction.

items.title: AI Study Helper (RAG Pipeline)
items.description: LLM-powered document retrieval for conversational Q&A over 200+ PDFs. Built semantic indexing with pgvector achieving 88%+ retrieval precision. 30% hallucination reduction vs baseline. Engineered agentic loops with 6+ query rewriting strategies.

items.title: Doctor-to-Human Translator
items.description: Fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B with QLoRA on clinical text simplification. Reduced medical jargon by 35% while maintaining 92%+ accuracy via multi-dataset training (15K+ samples). 0.87 Fleiss' Kappa inter-rater agreement across 12 medical specialties.

items.title: Blockchain & AI Autonomous Vehicles
items.description: Integrated SUMO traffic simulation with blockchain smart contracts for secure V2V communication across 100+ vehicles. Multi-model anomaly detection (TVAE-GMM, CNN, LSTM) achieving 95% accuracy, 0.91 F1-score, 15% false positive reduction.

items.title: Stock Price Prediction (LSTM)
items.description: Multi-layer LSTM time-series forecasting on 10+ years of market data. Engineered 15+ temporal features (moving averages, volatility indicators, lag signals). Achieved 91% directional accuracy, 18% RMSE improvement vs baseline regression.

items.title: MERN Blogging Platform
items.description: Full-stack blogging platform with authentication, CRUD operations, comments, and role-based access. Supported 200+ users with responsive UI. Optimized MongoDB schema design achieving 35% query efficiency improvement with strategic indexing.

items.title: AI Leaf Disease Diagnosis Rover
items.description: IT Department Hackathon Winner. AI-powered leaf disease detection for agricultural automation. Integrated computer vision and machine learning for real-time disease classification and severity assessment.

items.title: Facial Recognition System (OpenCV)
items.description: Real-time facial recognition using Haar Cascades across 500+ frames and 20+ users. Achieved 93% detection accuracy, 30% frame processing speedup, 16% false positive reduction through ROI tuning and parameter optimization.

items.title: Microservices Architecture (Accenture)
items.description: Architected and deployed 5+ backend microservices using NestJS, Node.js, SQL, and Spring Boot. Handled 10K+ daily API requests across 15+ endpoints. Reduced response latency by 20% through optimized schema design and strategic indexing.
